note: Actual speed moves toward the ordered speed. Ordered speed is what movement energy pays for (1 per speed point, including a half point). These bands are a clean-room fit to observed spool-up times. Each band adds gainHundredths once per overTicks, and the fraction divides the band width exactly, so the boundary is reached on a tick with a zero remainder. Deceleration is 110 hundredths per 30 ticks (1.1 speed per second) for every listed hull. A hull that is not listed keeps the per-order acceleration clamp and has no separate actual speed.
